chunks: And the King said, 'Bring him to me, that I may take him in special service for myself.' So when he spoke to him, he said, 'Indeed, you are today with us established in a rank of trust.'

key_terms.اسْتَخْلِصْهُ: To take him in special service / to select him exclusively

ai.seo_question: What position did the King offer Prophet Joseph?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition of Joseph from a prisoner to a trusted administrator, emphasizing his 'Amanah' (trustworthiness) as a divine attribute that qualified him for governance. The King's declaration underscores the meritocratic principle in Islamic leadership, where competence and integrity, rather than lineage, determine authority. This moment is often cited by scholars to illustrate the spiritual and administrative excellence expected of the Imams.
